div.p: Our academic advisors help you find the right program match.

Over $120M in scholarships and grants are awarded annually. Merit scholarships range from $5,000 to full tuition. Need-based aid is also available. Submit FAFSA or International Aid Form by January 15.
Register at apply.Axion.edu using your email address. Save your application ID — you'll need it for all further correspondence.
Fill in your personal details, academic history, intended program, and extracurricular activities. Applications take approximately 45 minutes to complete.
Upload your transcripts, test scores, two letters of recommendation, and a 500-word personal statement explaining your academic goals.
Pay the $75 application fee (waived for eligible low-income applicants). Applications are reviewed in the order received.
Decisions are sent via email within 6–8 weeks of your completed application. Early Decision results are released by February 1.
